nom: Good Molecules Moisturizing Rich Sunscreen SPF 30

avis.titre: So good it's part of my daily routine
avis.texte: Yall looking at the reviews scared me but it's genuinely so good. I have normal to mixed skin type, not sensitive at all so i cant talk for those with sensitice skin. For me, its perfect. Its lightweight and it moistures my skin and you cant any white streaks on my face.for the price i think this is a amazing product.
I wanted to love this so bad but it pills of my face in literal flakes if i breathe the wrong way

I usually love a lot of good molecules products so i thoughtt id like this one. at first i thought it was nice but throughout the day it made me feel itchy+ it made me look dry even though my skin felt soft. whatevers in it also seemed to bring out my fine lines more from im guessing what was drying me out. after a week i got some tiny acne spots from this product. I think the xantham gum in it just doesnt work for me

I decided to try the product out and use other good molecule products with it to give it a fair chance, but this sunscreen pills like no other, even with no makeup on! It comes off in flakey white scraps and I honestly cant recommend it to anyone

I want to start with saying this is my first skincare review! Woo! This is the first product I've used that has motivated me to leave one! < 3 I have VERY sensitive skin and I have spent many years trying to find a daily sunscreen + moisturizer that has a nice texture and doesn't cause irritation. I'm glad to say, I have finally found it! Because of my overly sensitive skin I am limited to mineral sunscreens and all I have tried are very heavy, greasy or sticky. This isn't any of those things! It goes on so smoothly, absorbs so well and feels so lightweight. Like most sunscreens it does take more than just few seconds to get it rubbed in all the way but once it is, there is no white cast. The only potential con is that I have noticed slight pilling when using a serum underneath and a foundation on top. But with just foundation on top I have not had any pilling! It makes me sad to see this has such a low review because it has been amazing for me! It is a fairly new product so I hope more people try it out and love it as much as I do so it stays on the market! The price is unbeatable! :)
I like this sunscreen. I'm a Yuka girlie and picky about my products. This scans clean and applies well. No white cast in my chocolate skin. I love the hydrating finish. Highly recommended!

avis.titre: Gave it a try, I like it!
avis.texte: I usually use the SPF 50 Byoma sunscreen fir my face but it's a bit pricey, so I wantes to try something different. I saw very mixed reviews about this sunscreen, but decided to try anyway. I didn't have any pilling with it under my makeup, and it didn't leave a white cast. I have skin on the oily side slightly, but I would def recommend!

I was a little disappointed by this product. I love Good Molecules. This sunscreen is very hydrating and give my skin a nice glow. I have acne and type 2 rosacea and my skin didn't react poorly to this SPF. It didn't make me break out or cause any rosacea flare ups. HOWEVER this SPF pills like CRAZYYYY!!! Even when I don't wear makeup over the top of it, it pills... even if you barely touch/rub your face. There is white flakes all over my face- it almost looks like my skin is dry and flaking off. When wearing makeup over the top of it, it caused my makeup to separate- I only wear a little bit of cream blush! So sad about this! Would love to buy it again if they fix this problem.

i use water based (not oil based) makeup over this sunscreen and have had zero issues with pilling. it absorbs quickly and does not leave a white cast for me. it doesn't burn my eyes. it smells weird but it isn't a bad smell, lol. it's moisturizing!

avis.titre: It's great for brown skin goes on smooth
avis.texte: I actually was just out of sunscreen and went to Ulta was scanning everything with the yuka app. This one came up completely clean it's cheap. I was surprised that it was a mineral sunscreen because it goes on so smooth.

A couple weeks back, I was really happy to buy the sunscreen because I liked this brand because of it's affordability, but when I applied the sunscreen, immediately I noticed the white casting, and it was a lot worse than other sunscreen as well. And it also felt really oily on my skin.
this product is so amazing feels so soft on this wonderful soft feeling on my skin for the whole day and doesn't make me break out doesn't make me oily. It's quite literally the best.
It has such a bad white cast and it dries way too quickly and pills quite badly. Don't waste your money like I did.

This gave me a delayed allergic reaction. Red, itchy patches on areas where I used it on. This was sent to me by mistake (bought a different product) but i thought I would give it a try. I knew this wasn't really an all 100%mineral sunscreen. (Ethylhexyl Methoxycrylene in its inactive ingredients, used as a chemical spf booster). Now I know I can't use this for sure.

I live in the sunshine state, so sunscreen is a must. I also have acne prone and fair skin. Most sunscreen breaks me out, but this has been wonderful. I disagree with the white cast, it gives a dewy finish. I rarely use it under makeup, as my la roche posay has spf already. If you want sunscreen that doesn't break you out and does its job well, this is it.
It makes your makeup pill. I thought I wasn't allowing enough time for the sunscreen to set but even when I wait 30 mins, my makeup pills. Please do not buy this product.
I really wanted to like this. Ive heard so many positive things about their products, but this does not absorb quickly nor is it brown skin friendly leaves a white/grey cast.

Today was my first time trying this sunscreen. It started pilling right away, to the point where I couldn't spread it all over my face. I will not be using or buying this again. Bummer, I love this brand!

I use a few other Good Molecules products & was happy to see yet another mineral sunscreen available, as chemical sunscreens really irritate my eyes. I liked that the SPF was 30 & wear it in the AM on top of my moisturizer, after cleansing my face. It's not as moisturizing as I hoped it would be, but it's still a good cruelty-free product that protects my face & neck under my foundation.

avis.titre: Great but not as good as the other formula
avis.texte: I really like this sunscreen. It's a thicker and creamier consistency than the formula they had before, but it can be tricky to layer over certain skincare. It can start to pull so just be careful

I wanted to like this so bad because i love the brand but i just don't. It leaves a strong white cast no matter how much i tried rubbing it in. It also pills sooo much! Throughout the day without me even touching it, it pilled all over my face. I looked like a lizard going through shedding! And spots where i thought it was rubbed in earlier, seemed to have a white cast later in the day.
I wish I returned this product when I had the chance. Its the worst suncreen I have tried, it pills very very bad. Dont waste your money on it.

I bought this product to wear under my make up but it leaves a slight white cast. I really have to work the product into my skin and then let it dry before applying any makeup/ primer. The sunscreen feels thick and grainy when distributing the product on my face. It works okay, but i can still see the white cast on myself. Unfortunately im going to have to use the sunscreen on days im going barefaced or beach days. I does the job but i feel cakey with this on. wouldnt buy again.

avis.titre: it's not buildable and it pills like crazy
avis.texte: I put it in the pros and cons but the stuff is very moisturizing however, it pills really bad, especially under foundation. it's not very buildable.
Unfortunately, I greatly fidlike this product. It smells quite strong of chemicals and peels like no other. Very disappointing.

This sunscreen is thick and moisturizing but it feels so uncomfortable and heavy on the face and takes far too long to absorb. If you try to touch your face or put makeup on sooner than an hour after application, you're going to end up with a pilling mess.

This product was great the forst tome i used! It was cheap and i thight it wiuld be a great product to add to my skin prep. However the second time i went to use it, I like to slather my face in sunscreen. This was not the product for that whatsoever. Flaked and peeled terribly.

it's a light formula and doesn't feel oily. however I noticed no matter what I do it always seems to pill. this is also a terrible combo with makeup because it will pill or make it hard to blend out concealer, bronzer, etc.
I don't find that this sunscreen is actually good when you're in an area with a UV above 5

avis.titre: afforable, moisturizing, and worked with my sensitive skin
avis.texte: I have eczema and sensitive skin. I have a hard time finding a sunscreen that doesn't burn my eyes and doesn't cause me to break out. I usually love all Good Molecules products and this one did not let me down! I find this to be a gentle spf for coolder temps due to the product being a little heavier. Haven't tried it with warm weather.

I'm surprised by all the negative reviews this sunscreen is getting, so I wanted to add my experience. I have medium tanned, acne prone oily skin and have trouble finding a sunscreen that doesnt make me breakout, look wet or leave a white cast. This one blends in so well with my other products (I use mostly good molecules and the ordinary, not sponsored!!!) and does not make me break out. I do wait at least 30 seconds between each product before adding the next one to my skin. There is a white cast for a few seconds, but it dries out beautifully and does not leave my already oily skin looking like I just finished running a marathon. It also has a nice smell to it, in my opinion. I wrote this so it doesn't get discontinued because I love it so much and so people don't hesitate to give it a try!

I'm super nervous everytime a product gets negative reviews, because those seem to be the ones that work for my skin. I have annoyingly sensitive and reactive skin, few SPFs work for me, but this one does. I wash with the cleanser, pat the essence in, apply brightening serum, then this SPF. I find that I don't need moisturizer underneath. I use the rich cream at night (another poorly rated one that I love). I hope this product doesn't get discontinued because for some of us, it works wonderfully.
Tried this product twice thinking my face was burned from another product. Made my skin so textured and red.

Started itching an hour after application, got a rash & hives after 3 hours. Painfully itchy cheeks, forehead, and especially ears. This product is NOT 100% mineral sunscreen, and they need to disclose that. They added chemical UV filters like many other misleading brands. It also has a few ingredients people are known to react to. Why even make a product if it won't work for the majority of people? I would say I wish I didn't react to it, but it's not really a good product in general anyways...Blends in fine but it pills really bad around my eyes almost immediately. I would not recommend for...most people.

The first time I used the sunscreen, I was in a rush and applied it not that long after applying my moisturizer. Once it started to pill I assumed the issue was not having enough time in between the two. But upon my second day of application, even with waiting a good 20 minutes in between it still pilled like crazy dispite me rubbing it in well. If you can get it to work for you it has a great finish, didn't burn my eyesr, and leaves no white cast. But I personally use the recommended two fingers application/ the quarter sized application and with using the recommended amount i couldn't get it to work for me unfortunately.

It does *not* leave a white cast if you properly cleanse & moisturize beforehand. Definitely hydrating. Can *sometimes* make my face itch slightly in allergy seasons but I have the most sensitive skin in the world so it's a miracle to me! No eye burning, no rash, no drying. Wonderful formula also.

avis.titre: obsessed! finally a sunscreen that doesnt break me out !
avis.texte: this sunscreen is amazing, no white cast, blends into skin and is perfect as a makeup primer. for those who dont like this you may be using too much or a too heavy moisturizer with it.
Thick and wiykdnt blend out.. love good molecules but this needs improvement 🥺

I'm someone who is both brown skin and uses only mineral sunscreen bc of a skin sensitivity and these officially taking over my mineral sunscreen slot. First, THERE IS NO WHITE CAST. I am NARS Marquise/Maybelline 360, so if there was a white cast I'd know but there is none. And I use two full fingers worth. I can't say why others are, maybe they aren't rubbing it in well? But I can say beyond a shadow of doubt there is no white cast on my brown skin. Secondly, it doesn't pill. Like before, can't say why other reviewers are experiencing pilling. I use the good molecules lightweight moisturizer + giant vanicream tub before this and primer, foundation, and sometimes more sunscreen after and I have yet to experience any pilling or even a hint of pilling. Lastly, amazing texture and food finish for a drugstore sunscreen. I like a glowy sunscreen and while this doesn't give me that, it doesn't look matte or oddly dry. It compliments my moisturizers well and doesn't take much elbow grease to rub in. Overall, I will definitely will definitely be my go to going forward.
I'm VERY light when it comes to skin tone, and this is leaving a white cast on me. It also pills severely around my lips. I will more than likely return this.

I was so looking forward to trying this. My skin is extremely dry so I've been looking for a moisturizing spf for another layer of moisturizer on top of my regular one. The application was fine but pretty much anywhere I touched my face right after applying and throughout the day would pill immediately. I wasn't wearing make up or anything else on top of it. I'm super bummed.

If you've been looking for a good mineral sunscreen, that doesn't leave a white cast then this one is for you! I have very dark skin and this leaves behind no cast on my face. It does take a little bit longer to rub into your face, but I love the way it feels and it is so moisturizing I definitely recommend.

I have super dry sensitive skin & most mineral sunscreens irritate my skin. This just released and for the price point I thought why not try it out. First off, haven't had any irritation or break outs. I apply my mineral sunscreen in small amounts slowly building up to help prevent a white cast and using that technique this has little to no whitecast!! It leaves you glowy without looking greasy. No crazy or weird SPF smell which is super nice too. I'd say the only "con" is that some might think it feels a little sticky after being rubbed in. I don't really mind it because once it soaks in and dries I don't notice it. But fresh after application it def feels a little tacky/sticky? I don't wear makeup so I'm not sure how it lays w/foundation, etc. Anyways, for sure my new favorite sunscreen & has a great rating on Yuka too!
